description: One room and a scullery behind a curtain. The bed folds up into a cabinet against the wall and the cabinet door has been off its top hinge for a while now. The window faces the green, which means washing, which means a grey light that is nonetheless daylight.

window.description: A sash window onto the drying green, painted shut at some point and then freed with a chisel by somebody impatient.
window.name: the green window

name: Unit 1
